summary: WebminPulse MVP validated end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/wrong-pw/me/401 without token), server CRUD, offline detection (10.255.255.1 returns last_status.online=false within ~10s), check-one & check-all, alert generation on online->offline transition (verified via Mongo state flip), DELETE /api/alerts clears, settings persistence, and register-push (bad body 422; valid body reaches upstream and returns 502 as expected with placeholder key). No password field leaked in server responses (list/get/update). Frontend: register->dashboard redirect works, empty state 'NO NODES CONNECTED' with Initialize button, add-server flow renders card with red OFFLINE badge, bottom tabs GRID/ALERTS/SYSTEM navigate correctly, Settings shows CPU/RAM thresholds and Disconnect Session (logout), tapping card opens detail with CPU/RAM/DISK gauges and sticky 'OPEN WEBMIN PANEL' button. Two non-blocking RN-web console warnings observed (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears from shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset used on FAB and summary dot. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (styles.fab and styles.dot). Non-blocking on native; consider Platform.select to use boxShadow on web.

React Native Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a library (LinearGradient/KeyboardAwareScrollView) — verify none of the app screens pass pointerEvents as prop; if any do, move to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow via Platform.select to silence RN-web deprecation warnings on FAB (app/(tabs)/index.tsx) and any other component using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset.
(Optional) Audit for any pointerEvents={...} prop usage and move to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id with projections {'_id': 0} and never returns the encrypted password field via server_public — good.
Passwords are encrypted at rest with Fernet (SERVER_ENC_KEY) and legacy plaintext fallback in dec_secret is acceptable for migration.

check_server sets result['online']=True BEFORE parsing JSON — any HTTP response (including 401/500) counts as online. This is correct for reachability but note: an auth-failing Webmin will still show ONLINE with null CPU/RAM. Consider gating online=True on 2xx/401 (auth reachable) if stricter semantics are desired.
Background poller runs every 30 min via asyncio.create_task in startup — no lock/guard against overlapping cycles if a cycle exceeds 30 min; unlikely at current scale.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral users test_<uuid>@example.com and uidetail_<ts>@example.com plus TEST_-prefixed servers; cleaned up all TEST_ servers in TestZZCleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Seeded credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md may not actually exist in DB (login returns 401) — tests use freshly-registered accounts. Offline-transition alert requires a prior online snapshot in server.last_status; test seeds this via direct pymongo write to mongodb://localhost:27017 db 'test_database'. Push upstream is a placeholder key → 502 is expected/acceptable. All CRUD/alerts/settings endpoints working.
